newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX closes bourse trade down 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: German DAX closes bourse trade down 0.5 pct.

text.p: 1247 GMT - German DAX index ends bourse down 0.5 percent from Thursday's records after a bout of profit-taking sparked by overnight losses on Japan and Wall Street and talk of an EMU delay. Dealers see outlook stable at lower levels, but still see potential for more gains next week.
* DAX index down 17.08 points at 3,259.64 points, off low of 3,251.77 points.
* March DTB DAX futures down 19 at 3,261.0.
* VW outperforms after strong January sales report.
* Market rises off lows after Bundesbank and Finance Ministry deny plans to issue statement on EMU.
